en.title: Did Bill Gates Predict the Spread of Mpox? No, It Was an NTI Preparedness Simulation Exercise
en.claim: American billionaire Bill Gates predicted and planned the current Mpox outbreak in advance during 2022 to profit from vaccines.
en.claimant: Viral Facebook posts and TikTok video conspiracy claims
en.verdictSummary: FALSE. The circulating video is an excerpt from a tabletop pandemic crisis simulation organized by the Nuclear Threat Initiative (NTI) in March 2021 to test global bio-security response systems. Bill Gates did not orchestrate or predict the real outbreak.
en.imageCaption: Viral claim falsely alleging a pre-planned biological outbreak orchestrated by Bill Gates.
en.explanation:
### Context of the Claim
In recent weeks, viral posts on Facebook and TikTok in Central and East Africa claimed that American philanthropist Bill Gates had foreseen and planned the spread of Mpox (monkeypox). The posts claimed: "Bill Gates pox has arrived. He predicted it and now it is here... listen carefully."

### Congo Check Verification Process
Our editorial desk investigated the origin of this video and claim:

1. **Origin of the Footage:** Reverse video analysis reveals the clip originates from a tabletop pandemic preparedness exercise hosted by the NGO **Nuclear Threat Initiative (NTI)** in March 2021 in Munich.
2. **The Simulation Scenario:** The exercise gathered former heads of state, public health leaders, and scientists to simulate an imaginary biological pathogen scenario set arbitrarily in May 2022. Organizers chose monkeypox simply as a recognized representative pathogen with known transmission profiles, not as a prophecy.
3. **Official Response from WHO:** Eugene Kabambi, communications officer at the World Health Organization (WHO) in Kinshasa, confirmed to Congo Check that these allegations are completely baseless conspiracy theories intended to instill distrust in legitimate medical counter-measures and vaccines.
4. **NTI Clarification:** In a formal statement, the Nuclear Threat Initiative reiterated: "The fact that monkeypox is currently spreading in multiple countries is a sheer coincidence. The risks posed by poxviruses have been studied and documented by virologists since 1958."

### Scientific Evidence
Monkeypox was first identified in laboratory monkeys in 1958 in Copenhagen, Denmark, and the first documented human infection occurred in 1970 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It is a zoonotic orthopoxvirus that has existed in wild mammalian reservoirs for centuries.

### Verdict
The claim that Bill Gates predicted or planned the Mpox outbreak is **FALSE**. The video depicts a hypothetical preparedness simulation conducted by an independent non-profit organisation.

sw.title: Je, Bill Gates Alitabiri Kuenea kwa Mpox? Hapana, Lilikuwa Zoezi la Kujiandaa la Shirika la NTI
sw.claim: Bilionea wa Marekani Bill Gates alitabiri na kupanga mapema kuenea kwa Mpox mnamo 2022 ili kupata faida ya kuuza chanjo.
sw.claimant: Machapisho ya virusi kwenye Facebook na video za uzushi kwenye TikTok
sw.verdictSummary: UONGO. Video inayosambazwa ni kipande kutoka kwa zoezi la uigaji wa kukabiliana na majanga ya kiafya lililoandaliwa na shirika la Nuclear Threat Initiative (NTI) mnamo Machi 2021. Bill Gates hakupanga wala kutabiri mlipuko halisi wa ugonjwa huo.
sw.imageCaption: Ujumbe wa uzushi unaodai kimakosa kuwa kuenea kwa Mpox kulipangwa kimakusudi.
sw.explanation:
### Muktadha wa Madai Haya
Katika wiki za hivi karibuni, machapisho yaliyosambaa kwa kasi kwenye mitandao ya kijamii kama Facebook na TikTok nchini DRC na nchi za Afrika Mashariki yalieleza kuwa bilionea Bill Gates alikuwa ametabiri mlipuko wa Mpox. Ujumbe huo ulisema: "Ugonjwa wa ndui wa Bill Gates umewasili. Alitabiri na sasa upo hapa... sikilizeni kwa makini."

### Ukaguzi na Uchunguzi wa Congo Check
Dawati letu la ukaguzi lilifanya uchunguzi wa kina kupitia itifaki yetu ya 3PFCP:

1. **Asili ya Video:** Utafutaji wa picha na video unathibitisha kuwa picha hizo zilitoka kwenye zoezi la uigaji wa janga lililofanyika Munich mwezi Machi 2021 na shirika la **Nuclear Threat Initiative (NTI)**.
2. **Uhalisia wa Zoezi Hilo:** Zoezi hilo lilikutanisha wataalamu wa afya na viongozi ili kujadili namna dunia inavyoweza kujiandaa iwapo janga jipya litatokea. Walichagua ugonjwa wa ndui ya nyani kama mfano wa kinadharia tu.
3. **Kauli ya Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO):** Eugene Kabambi, afisa wa mawasiliano wa WHO jijini Kinshasa, alithibitishia Congo Check kuwa habari hizi ni uzushi mtupu unaolenga kuwatisha wananchi wasipokee chanjo na matibabu sahihi.
4. **Ufafanuzi wa NTI:** Shirika la NTI lilitoa tamko rasmi: "Ukweli kwamba Mpox inasambaa katika nchi kadhaa ni tukio la kawaida la asili na si matokeo ya zoezi la uigaji. Virusi hivi vimekuwepo tangu mwaka 1958."

### Ushahidi wa Kisayansi
Virusi vya Mpox viligunduliwa kwa mara ya kwanza kwa nyani wa maabara huko Copenhagen mnamo 1958, na kisa cha kwanza cha binadamu kilirekodiwa katika Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo mnamo 1970. Ni ugonjwa unaotokana na wanyama pori na umekuwepo kwa miongo mingi.

### Uamuzi (Verdict)
Madai kwamba Bill Gates alitabiri au kupanga kuenea kwa Mpox ni **UONGO**. Video inayoonyeshwa ni ya zoezi la kujiandaa la kisayansi na si mpango wa siri.

en.title: Cassava Leaves and Sugarcane Juice Mixture Does Not Cure or Prevent Mpox
en.claim: Drinking a boiled concoction of crushed cassava leaves combined with pure sugarcane juice completely cures Mpox within 48 hours.
en.claimant: Widely shared WhatsApp voice notes circulating in Goma, Bukavu, and Uvira
en.verdictSummary: FALSE. There is zero clinical or pharmacological evidence that cassava leaves and sugarcane juice can eliminate the Mpox virus. Medical authorities warn that relying on unproven remedies delays essential medical care and risks severe complications.
en.imageCaption: Herbal remedy rumor falsely advertised as an anti-viral cure for Mpox.
en.explanation:
### The Rumor
A viral audio message in Swahili and French circulated extensively in North Kivu and South Kivu advising citizens to avoid clinics and instead boil cassava leaves (sombe) with sugarcane juice to treat monkeypox lesions.

### Scientific Verification
Congo Check interviewed Dr. Stephane Hans Bateyi, medical coordinator of the Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI) in North Kivu:

- **No Antiviral Action:** Neither cassava leaves nor sugarcane possess antiviral properties against Orthopoxviruses.
- **Risk of Toxicity:** Unprocessed or improperly prepared cassava leaves contain cyanogenic glucosides which can cause cyanide poisoning when ingested in concentrated quantities.
- **Delayed Care Warning:** Delaying hospital admission when suffering from Mpox can lead to secondary bacterial skin infections, sepsis, corneal scarring, and death.

### Official Treatment
Mpox must be managed in healthcare facilities using supportive care (pain management, nutritional support, antiseptic skin care) and antiviral therapeutics where indicated by licensed physicians.

### Verdict
This claim is **FALSE** and dangerous for public health.

sw.title: Mchanganyiko wa Majani ya Muhogo na Maji ya Miwa Si Dawa ya Kutibu Mpox
sw.claim: Kunywa mchanganyiko uliochemshwa wa majani ya muhogo (sombe) na maji ya miwa kunaponya ugonjwa wa Mpox ndani ya saa 48.
sw.claimant: Sauti ya WhatsApp iliyosambazwa kwa wingi huko Goma, Bukavu na Uvira
sw.verdictSummary: UONGO. Hakuna ushahidi wowote wa kitabibu au wa kisayansi unaothibitisha kuwa majani ya muhogo na miwa yanaua virusi vya Mpox. Madaktari wanaonya kuwa kufuata uzushi huu kunachelewesha matibabu hospitalini na kuhatarisha maisha.
sw.imageCaption: Dawa ya kienyeji inayodaiwa kimakosa kuwa tiba ya ugonjwa wa Mpox.
sw.explanation:
### Uzushi Huu Ulivyoanza
Ujumbe wa sauti kwenye WhatsApp ulisambaa sana katika maeneo ya Kivu Kaskazini na Kivu Kusini ukiwashauri wananchi wasiende hospitali bali wachemshe majani ya muhogo na maji ya miwa ili kuponya upele na vidonda vya Mpox.

### Ukaguzi wa Kisayansi
Congo Check ilizungumza na Dkt. Stephane Hans Bateyi, mratibu wa afya katika eneo la Kivu Kaskazini:

- **Hakuna Uwezo wa Kuua Virusi:** Majani ya muhogo wala maji ya miwa hayana kinga wala uwezo wa kuua virusi vya Orthopoxvirus.
- **Hatari ya Sumu:** Majani ya muhogo yasiyopikwa vizuri yana kemikali za cyanide ambazo zinaweza kusababisha sumu mwilini iwapo yatanywewa kwa wingi.
- **Ucheleweshaji wa Matibabu:** Mgonjwa anapochelewa kwenda kituo cha afya, vidonda vya Mpox vinaweza kupata maambukizi ya bakteria, uharibifu wa macho, au hata kusababisha kifo.

### Matibabu Sahihi
Wagonjwa wa Mpox wanapaswa kupelekwa mara moja katika vituo vya afya vilivyoidhinishwa ili kupata matunzo maalum, dawa za kutuliza maumivu na lishe sahihi.

### Uamuzi (Verdict)
Madai haya ni **UONGO** na ni hatari kwa afya ya jamii.

Sendwe General Reference Hospital Medical Directorate

en.title: True: Confirmed Mpox Patient Successfully Treated at Sendwe Hospital in Lubumbashi
en.claim: A woman suffering from laboratory-confirmed Mpox was admitted for specialized isolation and clinical care at Jason Sendwe Hospital in Lubumbashi.
en.claimant: Local community health monitors and medical reports in Haut-Katanga
en.verdictSummary: TRUE. Provincial health authorities in Haut-Katanga confirmed that a female patient exhibiting classic Mpox symptoms tested positive via PCR analysis and was safely isolated and treated under strict infection prevention protocols.
en.imageCaption: Jason Sendwe Reference Hospital in Lubumbashi, Haut-Katanga.
en.explanation:
### Verification
In mid-September 2024, reports surfaced stating that an Mpox patient had arrived at the Jason Sendwe General Reference Hospital in Lubumbashi.

Congo Check contacted Dr. Jean-Luc Kakudji, provincial minister of health for Haut-Katanga, and the hospital medical directorate:

- The patient, a 28-year-old resident, presented with fever, lymphadenopathy, and vesicular lesions.
- Swabs sent to the National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB) yielded positive PCR confirmation for Clade Ib Mpox.
- Contact tracing was enacted immediately and the patient responded favorably to hospital-based supportive care.

### Verdict
This report is **TRUE** and reflects verified epidemiological reporting.

sw.title: Kweli: Mgonjwa wa Mpox Alipokelewa na Kutibiwa Katika Hospitali ya Sendwe Huko Lubumbashi
sw.claim: Mwanamke mmoja aliyethibitishwa kuwa na maambukizi ya Mpox alilazwa kwa uangalizi maalum katika Hospitali ya Jason Sendwe jijini Lubumbashi.
sw.claimant: Taarifa za wahudumu wa afya na duru za kijamii jimboni Haut-Katanga
sw.verdictSummary: KWELI. Mamlaka za afya za mkoa wa Haut-Katanga zilithibitisha kuwa mgonjwa aliyekuwa na dalili za Mpox alipimwa na kukutwa na virusi kupitia kipimo cha maabara (PCR), na akawekwa katika wadi maalum ya wagonjwa wa kuambukiza.
sw.imageCaption: Hospitali ya Rufaa ya Jason Sendwe huko Lubumbashi, Haut-Katanga.
sw.explanation:
### Uthibitisho wa Taarifa Hii
Katikati ya Septemba 2024, taarifa zilisambaa kuwa mgonjwa wa Mpox amewasili katika Hospitali ya Rufaa ya Jason Sendwe huko Lubumbashi.

Congo Check iliwasiliana na idara ya afya ya jimbo la Haut-Katanga na uongozi wa hospitali:

- Mgonjwa huyo mwenye umri wa miaka 28 alikuwa na homa kali, kuvimba tezi na vipele mwilini.
- Vipimo vilivyotumwa katika maabara kuu ya INRB vilithibitisha maambukizi ya virusi vya Mpox aina ya Clade Ib.
- Mgonjwa alitengwa na kupatiwa matunzo hadi hali yake ilipopata nafuu.

### Uamuzi (Verdict)
Taarifa hii ni **KWELI** na imethibitishwa na vyanzo rasmi vya afya.

sources.title: European Commission Directorate-General for Health and Food Safety
Africa CDC Mpox Vaccine Delivery Oversight Committee

en.title: No, Mpox Vaccines Are Not a Western Plot to Depopulate Congo for Rwanda
en.claim: Mpox vaccines donated to the DRC are contaminated bioweapons created by the West to eliminate the Congolese population for the benefit of Rwanda.
en.claimant: Political influence accounts and sensationalist video blogs on Facebook and X
en.verdictSummary: FALSE. The MVA-BN vaccines received by the DRC were manufactured by Bavarian Nordic in Denmark and donated through the European Union and international public health partnerships. These identical vaccines have been administered safely across Europe and North America.
en.imageCaption: European Union donation of MVA-BN vaccines at N’djili International Airport in Kinshasa.
en.explanation:
### The Conspiracy
Following the arrival of the first batch of 265,000 vaccine doses at Kinshasa airport in September 2024, political bloggers claimed the vaccines were designed to sterilize or exterminate Congolese citizens amid geopolitical tensions.

### Our Verification
Congo Check verified the batch numbers, regulatory dossiers, and clinical safety approvals:

1. **Proven Safety Record:** The vaccine delivered is **MVA-BN (Modified Vaccinia Ankara - Bavarian Nordic)**, licensed as JYNNEOS in the United States and IMVANEX in Europe. Millions of doses have been administered safely worldwide since 2013.
2. **Identical Formulations:** The vials shipped to DRC are identical in formulation to those used across European hospitals and public health agencies.
3. **Independent Local Quality Control:** Samples were inspected and cleared by the DRC National Pharmacovigilance Committee and the Ministry of Health before deployment.

### Verdict
The claim is **FALSE** and exploits sensitive geopolitical conflict to undermine public trust in lifesaving medical interventions.

sw.title: Hapana, Chanjo ya Mpox Si Mpango wa Kuangamiza Wakongo kwa Faida ya Rwanda
sw.claim: Chanjo za Mpox zilizotolewa msaada kwa DRC ni silaha za kibiolojia zilizotengenezwa na nchi za Magharibi kuangamiza idadi ya watu wa Kongo kwa faida ya Rwanda.
sw.claimant: Akaunti za uchochezi wa kisiasa na kurasa za video kwenye Facebook na mtandao wa X
sw.verdictSummary: UONGO. Chanjo za MVA-BN zilizopokewa na DRC zilitengenezwa na kampuni ya Bavarian Nordic nchini Denmark na kutolewa kupitia Umoja wa Ulaya na mashirika ya afya ya kimataifa. Chanjo hizi zinafanana kabisa na zile zilizotumika kwa usalama barani Ulaya na Amerika.
sw.imageCaption: Msaada wa chanjo za MVA-BN kutoka Umoja wa Ulaya katika uwanja wa ndege wa N’djili jijini Kinshasa.
sw.explanation:
### Uzushi Huu wa Kisiasa
Baada ya kuwasili kwa shehena ya kwanza ya dozi 265,000 za chanjo jijini Kinshasa mwezi Septemba 2024, baadhi ya watu walisambaza madai ya uongo wakidai kuwa chanjo hizo zina sumu ya kuangamiza watu wa DRC.

### Ukaguzi wa Congo Check
Timu yetu ilikagua nyaraka za kiufundi na usalama wa chanjo:

1. **Usalama wa Kimataifa:** Chanjo iliyoletwa ni **MVA-BN**, inayojulikana kama JYNNEOS Marekani na IMVANEX Ulaya. Imetumika kwa miaka mingi na mamilioni ya watu duniani kote bila madhara ya sumu.
2. **Uthibitisho wa Maabara:** Mamlaka ya Dawa ya DRC na Kamati ya Kitaifa ya Uangalizi wa Dawa zilikagua shehena hiyo na kuthibitisha ubora na usalama wake.
3. **Ukweli Kuhusu Msaada:** Chanjo zilitolewa kama mshikamano wa dharura wa kukabili mlipuko unaoendelea katika bara la Afrika.

### Uamuzi (Verdict)
Madai haya ni **UONGO** na yanalenga kutumia siasa za kikanda kupinga jitihada za kuokoa maisha ya wagonjwa.

sources.title: Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Veterinary Health Guidance

en.title: False: Eating Thoroughly Cooked Pork Does Not Cause Mpox Contamination
en.claim: Eating pork meat directly infects humans with monkeypox and causes skin boils across the face.
en.claimant: Market rumors and social media panic in Lubumbashi butchers and food markets
en.verdictSummary: FALSE. Domestic swine are not reservoir hosts for Mpox. Mpox is transmitted between humans through close physical contact, or from wild rodents and primates via hunting and handling bushmeat. Standard cooked livestock meat poses no risk of Mpox.
en.imageCaption: Butchers and food markets in DRC affected by rumors regarding pork meat safety.
en.explanation:
### The Claim
Rumors circulating in markets across Katanga claimed that pork meat was banned by sanitary inspectors because pigs carry Mpox.

### What the Science Shows
Veterinary epidemiologists confirmed to Congo Check that:

- Mpox reservoir hosts in the wild are primarily rodents (such as rope squirrels, tree squirrels, and Gambian pouched rats) and non-human primates.
- Domestic pigs do not transmit Mpox to humans.
- Cooking meat thoroughly destroys any bacterial pathogens or foodborne micro-organisms.

### Verdict
The claim that eating pork transmits Mpox is **FALSE**.

sw.title: Uongo: Kula Nyama ya Nguruwe Hakusababishi Maambukizi ya Mpox
sw.claim: Kula nyama ya nguruwe kunasababisha maambukizi ya moja kwa moja ya ugonjwa wa Mpox na vipele usoni.
sw.claimant: Uzushi katika masoko na maduka ya nyama jijini Lubumbashi na Kolwezi
sw.verdictSummary: UONGO. Nguruwe wa kufugwa si wanyama wanaobeba virusi vya Mpox. Ugonjwa huu huambukizwa baina ya binadamu kwa kugusana kimwili au kutoka kwa wanyama pori (panya na nyani wa msituni). Nyama ya mifugo iliyopikwa vizuri haina hatari ya Mpox.
sw.imageCaption: Masoko na maduka ya nyama yaliyoathiriwa na uzushi kuhusu nyama ya nguruwe.
sw.explanation:
### Chanzo cha Uzushi
Madai yaliyoenea katika masoko ya Katanga yalisema kuwa serikali imepiga marufuku nyama ya nguruwe kwa sababu wanyama hao wanabeba virusi vya Mpox.

### Ukweli wa Kisayansi
Wataalamu wa mifugo na afya ya umma wamethibitishia Congo Check:

- Wanyama wanaoeneza Mpox porini ni panya maalum wa msituni na nyani, wala si nguruwe wa nyumbani.
- Nyama yoyote ya mfugo inapopikwa kwa joto la kutosha huua vijidudu vyote vya magonjwa.
- Njia kuu ya maambukizi kwa sasa ni mgusano wa karibu kati ya binadamu na binadamu kupitia ngozi, nguo au matone ya majimaji.

### Uamuzi (Verdict)
Madai kuwa kula nguruwe kunaeneza Mpox ni **UONGO**.

sources.title: North Kivu Provincial Health Division Weekly Epidemiological Report

en.title: Misleading: Karisimbi Health Zone Had Not Reached 1,000 Confirmed Mpox Cases
en.claim: The Karisimbi health zone in Goma has officially surpassed 1,000 confirmed Mpox cases and hospitals are collapsing.
en.claimant: Local sensationalist WhatsApp messages and radio soundbites
en.verdictSummary: MISLEADING. While Karisimbi is one of the active transmission hotspots in North Kivu, official surveillance recorded 312 cumulative suspected cases and under 90 laboratory-confirmed cases at the date of publication, not 1,000.
en.imageCaption: Health centers and treatment wards in Goma, North Kivu.
en.explanation:
### Context
Panic spread across Goma after viral messages alleged that one single health zone had surpassed 1,000 active patients, suggesting an uncontrollable surge.

### Data Verification
Congo Check cross-referenced the epidemiological figures with the Provincial Health Division (DPS) of North Kivu:

- Suspected cases in Karisimbi at the time stood at 312.
- Confirmed positive cases stood at 86.
- While health systems are under immense strain, inflating figures by more than 300% causes disproportionate public panic and hoarding of supplies.

### Verdict
The claim is **MISLEADING** because it inflates real clinical counts to trigger panic.

sw.title: Upotoshaji: Eneo la Afya la Karisimbi Halijafikisha Kesi 1,000 za Mpox
sw.claim: Eneo la afya la Karisimbi mjini Goma limefikisha kesi zaidi ya 1,000 zilizothibitishwa za Mpox na hospitali zimelemewa kabisa.
sw.claimant: Ujumbe wa hofu kwenye WhatsApp na vituo vya redio vya mitaani
sw.verdictSummary: UPOTOSHAJI. Ingawa Karisimbi ni moja ya maeneo yenye maambukizi mkoani Kivu Kaskazini, takwimu rasmi za idara ya afya zilionyesha kesi 312 zilizoshukiwa na kesi 86 zilizothibitishwa na maabara, na si kesi 1,000 kama ilivyodaiwa.
sw.imageCaption: Vituo vya afya na wadi za matibabu mjini Goma, Kivu Kaskazini.
sw.explanation:
### Hofu Iliyotokea Goma
Ujumbe uliosambaa mjini Goma ulisababisha taharuki ukidai kuwa eneo moja pekee limevuka wagonjwa 1,000, jambo lililosababisha watu kuogopa kwenda hospitali.

### Takwimu Halisi za Afya
Congo Check ilikagua ripoti ya kila wiki ya Divisheni ya Afya ya Mkoa wa Kivu Kaskazini (DPS):

- Idadi ya watu waliofanyiwa vipimo vya kushukiwa ilikuwa 312.
- Waliothibitishwa na maabara kuwa na virusi walikuwa 86.
- Kuzidisha idadi ya wagonjwa kwa zaidi ya mara tatu kunachochea hofu isiyo ya lazima katika jamii.

### Uamuzi (Verdict)
Madai haya ni **UPOTOSHAJI** kwa sababu yanakuza idadi halisi ili kuibua taharuki.

sw.alertSummary: Mpox huenezwa hasa kwa kugusana ngozi kwa ngozi na vidonda vya mgonjwa, nguo zilizotumiwa na mgonjwa, au matone ya mate kwa ukaribu mkubwa. Vipimo na matibabu yanatolewa bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya serikali.

guidelines.title: Epuka Kugusana Moja kwa Moja
guidelines.desc: Usiguse vipele, vidonda au majimaji ya mwili ya mtu anayeshukiwa kuwa na ugonjwa huo.

guidelines.title: Usafi wa Mikono
guidelines.desc: Nawa mikono mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na maji safi tiririka au tumia vitakasa mikono.

guidelines.title: Nenda Hospitali Mapema
guidelines.desc: Kuanza matunzo hospitalini mapema kunazuia madhara makubwa na kuokoa maisha.
